phase: Reference Mode Recovery — Sectoral Financial Positions / Phase D source-discrepancy localization
purpose: Diagnostic-only decomposition of the Phase C six-sector system residual into resident-sector additivity versus direct total-economy/external consistency. Phase D cannot promote a reference mode, change a tolerance, allocate a residual, or alter Accounting Spine readiness.

identities.domestic_sector_sum_net: net(S1M)+net(S11)+net(S12)+net(S13), each on F-F1 boundary with preregistered H/C F1 structural applicability
identities.X_net: represented W1 liabilities minus represented W1 assets
identities.six_sector_residual_decomposition: resident_additivity_residual + total_economy_external_residual must equal the six-sector residual up to computational epsilon

outputs: quarterly resident_additivity_residual for stock and flow
quarterly total_economy_external_residual for stock and flow
dominant component by absolute magnitude for each Phase C failing stock quarter
interpretation_rule: The diagnostic may localize the public-data inconsistency but cannot decide that either identity is dispensable. A direct S1 series may not replace the required H/C/F/G/BNR sector histories, and no discrepancy may be allocated to a sector.
